Triple clamps: MXA tested Applied SST 24 mm in place of stock 20 mm. Larger offset reduces geometric trail. Improved steering accuracy for some testers; did not eliminate all cornering issues. Exact resulting trail not published.
Link arm: MXA recommended longer Pro Circuit/Factory Connection link. Reported rear lowering about 10 mm, then 100 mm race sag. Recheck front/rear balance. This differs from the stock-link 115 mm workaround.
Fork springs: MXA recommended firmer fork springs. Earlier 2008 triple clamps do not directly fit the 2009 KYB fork. Do not treat the clamp change as a substitute for correcting the spring balance.
